title: Quaint Flaky Spanish Ham Croquettes
description: Savory Spanish croquettes filled with jamon iberico and fines herbes, deep fried to a golden brown, gluten free friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine diced jamon iberico, chopped fines herbes, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together gluten free flour and eggs to make a smooth batter.
Add the melted butter to the batter and mix well.
Add the jamon iberico mixture to the batter and mix until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small cylindrical croquettes.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully place the croquettes in the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Remove the croquettes from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the croquettes hot and enjoy.
